summarization.prompt:
You are summarizing a documentation page. The code examples have already been extracted and will be shown separately. Focus ONLY on the prose.

Produce 2-4 info snippets, each a short markdown section:

### Overview
1-2 sentence summary of what this page covers.

### Key Concepts
- Bullet points of important concepts, constraints, or gotchas.

### API Behavior Notes
- Notes on parameter behavior, edge cases, return values, etc.

DO NOT reproduce any code examples. Code is shown separately.
